author: alex_dev
title: fix(auth): handle expired token edgecase
raw_description:
Resolves issue where expired JWT tokens raise an unhandled 500 error instead of returning a clean 401 Unauthorized. Closes #123.

Included unit tests in tests/test_jwt_auth.py to verify token expiration behavior.

files.patch:
@@ -45,12 +45,45 @@ def verify_token(token_str: str):
+    try:
+        payload = jwt.decode(token_str, SECRET, algorithms=['HS256'])
+    except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
+        raise AuthenticationError('Token has expired', status_code=401)

@@ -10,2 +10,28 @@ def test_expired_token():
+    expired = create_test_token(expired=True)
+    response = client.get('/protected', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {expired}'})
+    assert response.status_code == 401

quick_checks.summary: Clean bug fix with accompanying unit tests and linked issue.
